name: Hukumonline

products: Online consultation with lawyers (phone/chat); lawyer app

notes: Dealroom has two profiles that disagree on whether outside funding exists.

name: Hukumku
products: Chat and video consultation with lawyers

name: Intelllex
products: Legal knowledge management for professional services

name: LuatVietnam
products: Vietnamese legal database since 1945; English translations; regulatory updates; document comparison; AI legal Q&A

products: Contract lifecycle management with AI review
notes: Latest data is from 2022 and may be out of date. Founded year from background knowledge.

name: Spellbook
products: AI contract drafting and review inside Microsoft Word

name: Luminance
products: AI contract review and automated negotiation
key_investors: Point72 | March Capital | Slaughter and May | National Grid Partners
notes: Total is from a company spokesperson. Founded year from background knowledge.

products: CoCounsel AI legal assistant (document review, research memos, deposition prep, contract analysis)

products: AI contract review; managed legal services
